key_insights: Testing the same support level repeatedly with increasingly weak bounces is a sign of weakness, not strength
High timeframe breakdowns (monthly) are worth taking seriously and haven't been reclaimed on BTC or ETH
Previous cycle arguments about not going below 20k for BTC are cope; markets can do things they've never done before
Luna collapse brings regulatory scrutiny to crypto that will last for years
SP500 trading like crypto (clean technical downtrend) is not healthy for overall market
Use fractals as risk management reminders, not deterministic predictions
Inactivity has been rewarded; no compelling long setups until reclaim or support is reached
summary: Both BTC and ETH remain in bearish trends below key support levels with no reclaim yet. Inactivity has been the winning strategy as high timeframe breakdowns haven't resolved. No compelling long setups exist until either support is reclaimed or price reaches deeper value zones ($14-20k BTC, $600-1000 ETH). Testing the same levels repeatedly with weaker bounces is bearish, not bullish. Regulatory risk from Luna collapse will continue to pressure markets.
